{"body_md": "## Problem

Garage estimates uploaded to Keelwater are being assigned the wrong document category and filed as correspondence, forcing claims handlers to manually recategorise them. This manual correction causes delays and creates a risk that critical evidence is overlooked during claims processing.

## Who is affected

- 6 accounts have raised this issue across 14 mentions, representing 4500000.0 GBP in ARR [i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:10727c617a1f4506][i:3fa3eaf44b4d7c2f][i:71de0c62620ee6ab][i:d8352b80a8797730][i:f51ad41373d3cadc]
- Linnet House Insurance, Saltmarsh Specialty, Brackwater Homecover, Marrowgate Commercial, Cindermill Trade Cover and Thistlecombe Mutual have all reported garage estimates landing in correspondence [i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:10727c617a1f4506][i:3fa3eaf44b4d7c2f][i:766f9ca2be319649][i:d8352b80a8797730][i:f51ad41373d3cadc]
- The issue has been raised through 3 routes: account_management, support and onboarding [i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:10727c617a1f4506][i:71de0c62620ee6ab]
- 1 renewal falls within the next 90 days, for Marrowgate Commercial on 2026-12-12 [i:766f9ca2be319649]

## Evidence

- Linnet House Insurance reported that every time a garage estimate gets dumped into correspondence, someone has to manually fix it, and sometimes the wrong document category means evidence gets overlooked entirely [i:0fc6cb6155656fe2]
- Saltmarsh Specialty reported that garage estimates keep landing in correspondence, requiring manual recategorisation, and that the incorrect file type assignment is causing real delays and oversight risks [i:10727c617a1f4506]
- Saltmarsh Specialty also reported that handlers are spending too much time fixing incorrect file type assignments and that a better way to classify garage estimates is needed so critical evidence is not missed during claims processing [i:35bc60912c19d67e]
- Brackwater Homecover reported that every time a garage estimate is uploaded it lands in correspondence, that this is a wrong document category, and that handlers keep missing key evidence because of it, which delays claims resolution [i:a3f2a53f98cd8130]
- Marrowgate Commercial reported that when garage estimates are uploaded they land in the wrong document category, like under Correspondence, and that the team has to manually move them, which risks things slipping through the cracks [i:766f9ca2be319649]
- Cindermill Trade Cover reported that uploaded documents sometimes end up misfiled, with garage estimates tagged as correspondence, and that handlers have to move them manually, which risks missing critical evidence [i:d8352b80a8797730]
- Thistlecombe Mutual reported that the document upload system keeps assigning the wrong category, such as putting repair quotes under correspondence, which leads to incorrect file type issues [i:f51ad41373d3cadc]
- Marrowgate Commercial also raised unrelated issues in the same feedback, including lockout messages caused by their own customer network failure and a Claims Tasks panel that moved without warning [i:71de0c62620ee6ab]

## Why now

- 14 mentions across 6 accounts have been logged as of 2026-10-01, spanning account_management, support and onboarding routes [i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:10727c617a1f4506][i:71de0c62620ee6ab]
- Marrowgate Commercial, the largest affected account at 1600000.0 GBP ARR, renews on 2026-12-12, within the next 90 days [i:766f9ca2be319649]
- The affected accounts together represent 4500000.0 GBP in ARR, with 1 renewal due within 90 days [i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:10727c617a1f4506][i:3fa3eaf44b4d7c2f][i:71de0c62620ee6ab][i:d8352b80a8797730][i:f51ad41373d3cadc]
